name: Hardcastle and Waud Manufacturing Company Limited
about: Hardcastle and Waud Manufacturing Company Limited engages in chemical activities in India. It operates through Industrial Chemicals, Investing, and Leasing Activities segments. The company also engages in investment activities; and trades in industrial chemicals. In addition, it offers job work and property leasing services. Hardcastle and Waud Manufacturing Company Limited was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Mumbai, India.
